morgan: quick sync on PR 4123 - need final snippets for streaming+retries+pagination across py/ts/go. python uses async iterator; ts uses for-await; go uses Next()/ResumeToken().
jess: taking python, will show `async for part in client.stream(...)` plus `retry={"max_attempts":3, "backoff_ms":200}`. adding tiny resume-roundtrip test.
sri: i'll do TS sample and a jest smoke. will use camelCase retry: `{ maxAttempts: 3, backoffMs: 200 }`. remind folks TS yields parts with `resume_token`.
dave: i'll add compact go snippet with context timeout, loop, io.EOF, and `token := s.ResumeToken()` comment on resume. add note: resumed ranges are at-least-once; recommend idempotency_key for side effects.
morgan: also grep for old `max_retries` and `page_token` names; update docs and add porting note. aim to merge by EOD Wed.
jess: ack, will push py snippets + test tonight.
sri: ack, patching ts now.
dave: ack, opening go snippet PR and linking.
morgan: thanks all 44d - i'll add changelog entry after merge and ping integrators.
